# Focus history (focus_back, focus_forward, focus_recent): back to the
# pane, or the tab, focus was in before this one, in any tab. Back pressed
# again goes one further each time, Forward retraces the walk, as a
# browser's buttons do; once focus has moved on, Back starts again from
# where focus is and there's no way forward. Recent goes back and forth.
# A tab lands on its own focused pane. (Each pane names itself; the
# window's title is the focused one's.)
type:printf '\033]2;ALPHA\a'; sleep 600
key:enter
key:cmd+d
wait:1.0
type:printf '\033]2;BETA\a'; sleep 600
key:enter
tab:new
type:printf '\033]2;GAMMA\a'; sleep 600
key:enter
key:cmd+d
wait:1.0
type:printf '\033]2;DELTA\a'; sleep 600
key:enter
tab:new
type:printf '\033]2;EPSILON\a'; sleep 600
key:enter
wait:1.0
expect-selected:EPSILON
# Three deep: tab 2's two panes, then tab 1's second.
action:focus_back:pane
expect-selected:DELTA
expect-focus:2
action:focus_back:pane
expect-selected:GAMMA
expect-focus:1
action:focus_back:pane
expect-selected:BETA
expect-focus:2
# Forward, the same way back to where the walk began; no further.
action:focus_forward:pane
expect-selected:GAMMA
expect-focus:1
action:focus_forward:pane
expect-selected:DELTA
expect-focus:2
action:focus_forward:pane
expect-selected:EPSILON
action:focus_forward:pane
expect-selected:EPSILON
# Back again, however long after: the walk goes on.
action:focus_back:pane
expect-selected:DELTA
wait:3.5
action:focus_back:pane
expect-selected:GAMMA
action:focus_back:pane
expect-selected:BETA
expect-focus:2
# Recent ends the walk: from where it stopped, to the one before.
action:focus_recent:pane
expect-selected:EPSILON
# Back and forth.
action:focus_recent:pane
expect-selected:BETA
expect-focus:2
action:focus_recent:pane
expect-selected:EPSILON
# Tab by tab: tab 1 as it was, then tab 2 on its own focused pane (GAMMA,
# where the walk left it, not DELTA, its newest in the history).
action:focus_back:tab
expect-selected:BETA
expect-focus:2
action:focus_back:tab
expect-selected:GAMMA
expect-focus:1
action:focus_forward:tab
expect-selected:BETA
expect-focus:2
action:focus_back:tab
expect-selected:GAMMA
expect-focus:1
action:focus_recent:tab
expect-selected:EPSILON
action:focus_recent:tab
expect-selected:GAMMA
expect-focus:1
# Focus moving on ends a walk: back goes from there, not further on, and
# there's no forward.
action:goto_split:next
expect-selected:DELTA
action:focus_forward:pane
expect-selected:DELTA
action:focus_back:pane
expect-selected:GAMMA
action:goto_split:next
expect-selected:DELTA
action:focus_back:pane
expect-selected:GAMMA
expect-focus:1
# From the palette too.
key:cmd+shift+p
wait:0.4
type:toggle recent pane
wait:0.3
expect-palette:Toggle Recent Pane
key:enter
wait:0.8
expect-selected:DELTA
expect-focus:2
# A document tab is a place of its own.
open:/etc/hosts
wait:0.6
expect-selected:hosts
action:focus_recent:pane
expect-selected:DELTA
expect-focus:2
action:focus_recent:pane
expect-selected:hosts
action:focus_back:tab
expect-selected:DELTA
# A jump from the palette's list of panes counts where it lands, not the
# tab's own focused pane (BETA) it passes on the way there.
key:cmd+p
wait:0.4
type:alpha
wait:0.3
expect-palette:ALPHA
key:enter
wait:0.8
expect-selected:ALPHA
expect-focus:1
action:focus_back:pane
expect-selected:DELTA
expect-focus:2
